description: Adaptive-difficulty configuration for PrepVista (the DifficultyController in base.py). Defines difficulty levels and their scoring weights, what each DifficultyMode resolves to, how a requested level is clamped to a category's allowed band (see categories.json), and the AUTO controller's adaptive logic. Weights are cross-checked against scoring_config.json.

difficulty_levels.label: Easy
difficulty_levels.description: Fundamentals and warm-up questions; builds confidence.

difficulty_levels.label: Medium
difficulty_levels.description: The standard bar most interviews set.

difficulty_levels.label: Hard
difficulty_levels.description: Stretch questions that separate strong candidates.

difficulty_modes.label: Adaptive
difficulty_modes.description: The controller raises or lowers difficulty within the category's band based on recent performance.

difficulty_modes.label: Normal
difficulty_modes.description: Starts at the easy end of the category's band.

difficulty_modes.label: Medium
difficulty_modes.description: Holds at medium (clamped into the band).

difficulty_modes.label: Difficult
difficulty_modes.description: Starts at the hard end of the category's band.

band_clamping.rule: A requested level is clamped to the category's allowed [low, high] band.
examples: 'difficult' on an easy-medium category (e.g. culture_fit) -> medium.
'normal' on a medium-hard category (e.g. group_discussion) -> medium.
'medium' is valid for every category and is the universal safe default.

cold_start.note: Hold at medium for the first 2 answered questions until there's enough signal to adapt.

step_up.note: Raise difficulty by one level after 2 consecutive answers at or above 7.5/10.

step_down.note: Lower difficulty by one level after a single answer below 4.0/10, to rebuild confidence.

hysteresis.note: Scores between the step-down and step-up thresholds hold the current level, preventing oscillation.

auto_controller.note: The controller never jumps more than one level at a time and never leaves the category's band.

per_mode_resolution.auto: Use the cold-start hold, then adapt via step_up/step_down within the band.
per_mode_resolution.normal: Resolve to the band's lowest level (>= easy).
per_mode_resolution.medium: Resolve to medium (clamped into the band).
per_mode_resolution.difficult: Resolve to the band's highest level (<= hard).
